s.t:
Specific duties include: Serves as primary advisor to the Training Assistant Director, Compensation Service (CS) on all programs and major missions falling under the purview of the Training Operations Manager staffs-such as the Warrior Training Advancement Class (WARTAC) and Competency Based Training (CBT).

Exercises authority over a staff of employees responsible for the design, development and delivery of training on a national level. Prioritizes and delegates workload responsibilities and assignments based on directional/mission requirements and allocated resources, and employee skill level.

The incumbent is delegated managerial authority to plan for long range staffing needs, determine operational goals and objectives that warrant additional emphasis and assure the implementation/delivery of training needs.

Responsible for employee performance management; conducts interviews, makes recommendations to executive leadership on promotions, awards, reassignments etc. Hears and resolves issues/concerns from subordinates; administers disciplinary actions and refers serious concerns to the Assistant Director over the staff.

Evaluates the needs of the team, takes appropriate actions to ensure cohesion. Serves as a coach/mentor to employees; recognizes strengths and weaknesses, ensures recommended training is delivered to staff; and encourages/approves staff to seek professional developmental opportunities.

Represents the Compensation Service Training Assistant Director, Deputy Executive Director, and sometimes Executive Director in meetings with VBA Executive leadership; conducts briefings based on studies/program data and makes recommendations.

Negotiates on behalf of the CS Training Assistant Director and has the authority to make commitments on their behalf. Recommends and oversees the implementation of innovative programs and new approaches that improve the effectiveness of programs.

Considers objectives, program needs and associated costs; VA priorities, and the availability of subject matter experts in formulating recommendations. Provides status reports on the progress of the training-related initiatives and establishes goals and tracks the progress of those efforts toward meeting established milestones.

Ensures that the organizations strategic plan, mission, vision and values are communicated to the team and integrated into the team's strategies, goals, objectives, work plans and work product and services. Responsible for overarching identification of program improvements; utilizes data from any VA source.

Also ensures training needs are identified from VBA leadership, Regional Office (RO) leadership and non-leadership RO employees are addressed on CBTS and WARTAC. Directly manages and is accountable for all aspects of the planning, coordination, and execution of CBTS and WARTAC national training initiatives.

This includes setting up training sites, surveys, selecting and coordinating instructors, assignment of students, in conjunction with other VBA staff elements.

Works in concert with VBA senior leadership in Office of Field Operations, Regional Offices, and the Office of Human Capital Services, as well as the Department of Defense in identifying needs and assigning employees to attend training sessions.

Conducts site visits to military installations to meet with leadership, build relationships, observe, and assess training operations, performance, and quality.

The incumbent has extensive knowledge of a wide range of qualitative, quantitative methods for the assessment and improvement of program effectiveness or the improvement of complex management processes and systems.

We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to improve how we use data across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and billing.
Your main responsibility is to understand how our revenue processes perform and why results change. You will define metrics, combine data from different systems, investigate patterns, and test assumptions.
Your analyses should lead to measurable improvements. This may involve a better decision, a change to an existing process, or an automation that removes manual work and improves reliability.
Reporting and dashboards are part of the role, but they are not the objective. Each analysis should answer a relevant business question and provide a clear basis for the next decision.
You will also implement selected solutions, including data models, dashboards, and automations. Analysis remains the main focus. Implementation follows when the expected impact and method of measurement are clear.
Previous professional experience is useful but not required. We value analytical judgement, accuracy, technical understanding, and the ability to learn.
Tasks
Analyse the customer journey from acquisition and conversion to retention and revenue.
Define and maintain consistent metrics across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and finance.
Extract, combine, clean, and validate data from operational and analytical systems.
Investigate changes in customer behaviour, funnels, conversion rates, retention, costs, and revenue.
Determine the likely causes of performance changes instead of only describing the result.
Review existing reports and identify unreliable metrics, missing data, and conflicting definitions.
Develop hypotheses and test them against the available data.
Distinguish evidence from assumptions, correlations, and opinions.
Estimate the expected impact of proposed changes and define how success will be measured.
Prioritise opportunities based on impact, effort, and the reliability of the supporting data.
Present findings and recommendations in a form that supports business decisions.
Build selected dashboards, data models, automations, and process improvements.
Measure implemented changes and assess whether they produced the expected result.
Use AI assistants as a daily tool for research, data exploration, coding support, and documentation.
Verify AI-generated results against the underlying data and original sources.
Document metric definitions, data logic, assumptions, methods, and limitations.

Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving problems.
A high standard for data quality and reliable results.
General programming knowledge and an interest in developing your technical skills.
Initial experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, APIs, spreadsheets, data warehouses, or business intelligence tools is beneficial.
A basic understanding of statistics, including the difference between correlation and causation.
The ability to examine a problem from different perspectives before reaching a conclusion.
Interest in using AI assistants as part of analytical and technical work.
The judgement to review AI-generated results critically.
The ability to explain complex findings in clear language.
The motivation to learn unfamiliar tools, systems, and business areas.
The discipline to follow an analysis until the result is sufficiently reliable.
You’ll always know what’s expected of you, and you’ll work in an environment where mistakes are seen as valuable opportunities to learn.

s.h: A Shared Commitment to Outstanding Results
s.t: Our team is passionate about achieving excellence and values your contribution as an essential part of our success. Together, we accomplish great things.
We encourage self-motivation and personal accountability, empowering you to deliver exceptional results.
You’ll receive direct and timely feedback, enabling you to adapt quickly to change and continuously improve.
We foster open communication and actively support your personal and professional growth.

s.h: A Results-Driven Mindset Focused on Company Success
s.t:
Our goal is to achieve results that move the company forward. Your commitment to our shared success is highly valued.
Team Days, Summer Parties, and Christmas Celebrations: Regular events that strengthen team spirit and make work more enjoyable.
Corporate Benefits: Enjoy a range of employee discounts and perks.
Dog-Friendly Workplace: Bring your four-legged friend to work.
Bike Leasing: Take advantage of our bike leasing program for a greener and healthier commute.
You will not receive a fixed list of reports to produce. You are expected to question unclear results, challenge weak definitions, and form your own view based on the data.
Important questions should be followed from the initial analysis to a verified conclusion. Where a change is justified, you will help implement it and measure its effect.
The role requires initiative, persistence, and responsibility for outcomes. It does not require permanent availability. We assess work based on its quality, reliability, and business impact rather than time spent online.
You will receive support while taking responsibility for your own areas of analysis. You will have room to improve existing methods and introduce better approaches.
Equal Opportunity
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Hiring decisions are based on skills, potential, and suitability for the role.

Support audit and compliance program management for cross-functional efforts (evidence gathering, stakeholder alignment, remediation tracking).
Partner effectively with Product/Engineering, Legal, Customer Success, Finance, and EOR Ops leadership to align on cross-domain operational requirements and enable smooth execution across multiple surfaces (e.g., Payroll + PEO + EOR).

Legal Programs is responsible for providing management support, assistance and advice, and policy guidance regarding legal process and procedures for the United States Attorneys in a wide variety of program areas, including: affirmative civil enforcement, appellate, asset forfeiture, bankruptcy, border and immigration, child exploitation, civil defensive litigation, civil rights, eDiscovery, financial litigation, health care fraud, human trafficking, narcotics, Native American issues, victim­ witness, and violent crime.

Legal Programs coordinates all aspects of these programs, including training, funding, legislation, administration, outreach, and programmatic assessment.

About GENUINE
GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend.
To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment.
The Mission
You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid.
You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability.
Aufgaben

Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements.
Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions.
You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital.
Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software
Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share).
Qualifikation
Your Profile
Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus.
Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel.
Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD.
Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.).

What’s In It For You
Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands.
A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed.
Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects.
The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee).
Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry.
Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere.
We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you.

GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai.

There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops.

Wir sind stolz darauf, mit Europas führenden Fintechs und Finanzinstituten wie DKB, Revolut, N26 und Raisin zusammenzuarbeiten. Upvest wurde 2017 von Martin Kassing gegründet und vereint heute über 270 talentierte Fachkräfte aus mehr als 70 Nationen.

Upvest wird durch ein Gesamtinvestment von 280 Mio. € von erstklassigen Investoren unterstützt, darunter BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures sowie Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital und Motive.

Unsere jüngste Finanzierungsrunde über 110 Mio. € im März 2026 – angeführt von Sapphire und Tencent – dient als massiver Katalysator für unser Wachstum und ermöglicht es uns, ein erstklassiges Investment-Erlebnis zu bieten.
Revolutioniere die Altersvorsorge in Deutschland
Wir suchen einen Junior Operations Manager (f/m/d) rund um das Thema Altersvorsorgedepot, der die operativen Prozesse für diesen zentralen Geschäftsbereich durchführt.

Verantwortung und Durchführung von Übertragungen, Zulagenmanagement, Bonusanträgen sowie der steuerlichen Abwicklung und dem Edge-Case-Handling unter strikter Einhaltung von SLAs und KPIs.
Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung zum zentralen Fachexperten für alle Themen des operativen Tagesgeschäfts.
Fachliche Unterstützung der Kundenteams bei der Betreuung ihrer Endnutzer sowie Beantwortung komplexer Fragestellungen rund um die Altersvorsorge.
Laufende Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI, Automatisierungstools und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit.
Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs sowie proaktive Adressierung von Risiken unter strikter Beachtung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und interner Richtlinien.

Grundlegendes Verständnis der Marktregeln sowie der gängigen Altersvorsorgeprodukte (insbesondere Riester-Rente).
Kenntnisse der rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis für den Datenaustausch mit der Zentralen Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen ( ZfA ).
Großes Interesse an der Arbeit mit künstlicher Intelligenz und der aktiven Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag.
Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit auch in Zeiten hohen Arbeitsaufkommens sowie ein gewissenhaftes Terminmanagement.
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative verbunden mit einer ausgeprägten Teamfähigkeit.

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit tiefem fachlichem Fokus auf die Riester-Rente sowie die damit verbundenen operativen Prozesse.
Fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung unter Einsatz von Visualisierungstools sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. n8n).
Praktische Erfahrung im produktiven Umgang mit Large Language Models (wie Claude) oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Lösungen.

Arbeit mit Mehrwert: Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die die Zukunft des Investierens in Europa prägen wird. Unsere Arbeit ist komplex, ambitioniert und sinnstiftend. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und schaffst etwas völlig Neues - ohne Legacy-Systeme, ohne Grenzen.
Wohlbefinden: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Jahresurlaub und profitiere von Sport- und Gesundheitsbenefits für einen aktiven Lebensstil. Zusätzlich hast du Zugang zu vertraulichem, professionellem Coaching und kannst bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Nach jeweils vier Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du außerdem UpRest, ein voll bezahltes Sabbatical von einem Monat.
Weiterentwicklung: Wachstum liegt in unserer DNA. Jede:r Upvenger verfügt über ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, wie es eingesetzt wird.
Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite hybrid oder remote aus einem unserer Hubs in Berlin, London oder Tallinn - oder standortunabhängig innerhalb Europas, abhängig von der Rolle. Wir geben dir die Wahl und das Budget, dort zu arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist: zu Hause oder im Büro. Du entscheidest.
Vergütung & Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Wir sind überzeugt, dass alle Upvenger zu unserem Erfolg beitragen. Deshalb bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, überdurchschnittliches Gehalt sowie eine Teilnahme an unserem Mitarbeiter:innen-Beteiligungsprogramm.
Team-Events & Feiern: Nimm an unternehmensweiten Events wie UpFest, Team-Dinners, Offsites oder unserer Holiday Party teil, um dich zu vernetzen und gemeinsame Erfolge zu feiern.
Inklusion: Wir fördern eine Kultur, in der sich alle zugehörig fühlen und entfalten können. Unsere Employee Resource Groups stärken Vielfalt, Inklusion und Vernetzung, zum Beispiel durch Upfem für unsere weiblichen Upvenger oder UpVergent, das Unterstützung für neurodivergente Upvengers und Allies anbietet.

Make it easy for others. Wir vereinfachen Komplexes und handeln stets mit den besten Absichten.
Own the outcome. Wir sind proaktiv, schnell und entscheidungsstark. Dabei zählt für uns Fortschritt mehr als Perfektion.
Rise to the challenge. Wir denken groß und gehen über Grenzen hinaus. Neugier treibt uns an, wir lernen kontinuierlich und feiern Erfolge gemeinsam.
Tell the story. Wir starten mit dem Warum - ein gemeinsame Mission gibt Richtung. Transparenz und Wissensaustausch helfen uns, andere zu befähigen und zu inspirieren.
Upvest ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein.

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.

As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d) you own Process Excellence across the entire customer lifecycle. You design, implement, and govern the cross-functional processes that connect Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Enablement.
You start with the commercial outcome: understanding how a process impacts conversion, retention, efficiency, or revenue before designing the solution. By combining process design, automation, AI, and operational rigor, you ensure our GTM engine scales consistently across markets, reduces friction, and protects conversion from lead generation through renewal and expansion.
RevOps at plancraft is a commercial function, not a service desk. You operate as a strategic GTM partner and use systems, data, automation, and enablement as levers to drive business outcomes. This role is set up with a clear growth path.

Depending on your experience and the impact you demonstrate, it is designed to grow into a Team Lead position for our Operations Managers. We want you to prove operational excellence first, set standards the wider team follows, and grow into leadership from there. For a strong candidate with prior lead exposure, that path can be shorter.

Own and continuously improve cross-functional GTM processes across lead generation, sales, onboarding, activation, retention, renewal, and expansion.
Design, implement, document, and govern scalable process standards that improve efficiency and commercial performance.
Define and standardize lifecycle stages, handoffs, and SLAs across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Enablement.
Monitor process performance, identify conversion leakage, and drive measurable improvements across the customer lifecycle.
Build and maintain AI-powered automations and workflows that eliminate manual work and increase operational leverage.
Lead operational rollouts across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Spain, and Italy while adapting processes to local market requirements.
Translate strategic market priorities into scalable execution, including onboarding journeys, workflows, content operations, and tool configurations.
Build and own the GTM Process Library as the single source of truth for process documentation, onboarding, and change management, and set the standards our Operations Managers work to.
Coach our Operations Managers (Sales Ops, CS Ops, Marketing Ops) on process design, automation, and governance, raising the bar for how the team operates.
Own cross-functional process change from design and stakeholder alignment through rollout, adoption, and impact measurement.
Partner closely with Operations Managers to review process design, resolve cross-functional challenges, and establish consistent operating standards.
Enable GTM teams through documentation, training, and process best practices, with a focus on driving lasting behavior change.
Run regular process audits, KPI reviews, and operational health checks as a recurring cadence the team follows, to ensure process integrity and adoption.

4–7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations within a B2B SaaS environment.
Proven experience owning cross-functional GTM processes end-to-end, from design and rollout to governance and optimization.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and build right-sized solutions.
Data-driven mindset with experience using qualitative and quantitative insights to improve commercial performance.
Hands-on experience building AI and automation workflows with tools such as n8n, Make, or similar platforms.
Deep HubSpot expertise , including lifecycle stages, workflows, routing, segmentation, governance, and reporting.
Strong systems thinking with a focus on scalable architecture, process clarity, and operational excellence.
Ability to influence stakeholders through structure, communication, and sound judgment rather than formal authority.
Experience with Notion, business intelligence tools, and operational documentation.
Fluent English.
Track record of delivering measurable process improvements with clear business impact.

Experience mentoring or coaching operations people, or setting standards other operators follow.
Interest in growing into a people-leadership role, with evidence you can raise the bar across a team.
Experience working with SPICED, ICP frameworks, or similar GTM methodologies.

s.h: Solid SQL skills and experience working with data warehouses.
s.t:
Fluent or near-fluent German.
Experience supporting multi-market GTM organizations across Europe.
Familiarity with product-led growth or self-serve operating models.
Additional language skills in Spanish, Italian, or Dutch.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values.

As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey.

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Fraud Operations Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle ’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents.

Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead.

We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time: Sunday – Thursday, 8:00 am – 4:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

For this Fraud Operations Analyst the compensation range is $1,500 - $2,000 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry. What You'll Do:
Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
Attention to detail and ability to multitask
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong business judgment and communication skills
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
Able to work through holidays
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus
Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer

The Operations Manager is responsible for the operational activities of a variety of functional departments, distribution center(s), or facility(ies). Reviews and analyzes reports, records, and directives, and confers with managers/ supervisors to obtain data required for planning activities, such as new commitments, status of work in progress, and problems encountered.

Roles & Responsibilities: May be responsible for one or more of the following activities related to the receiving, storing, and/ or shipping of materials or finished goods.

May be responsible for ensuring materials are received from proper vendors, delivered to inventory, and finished goods, are available to meet production schedules, packaged according to specification and shipped in a timely manner. Ensures the security and accountability of materials and goods with inventory control.

May evaluate current procedures and practices for accomplishing department objectives and develop and implement improved procedures and practices. Gives work direction, resolves problems, and sets deadlines to ensure timely completion of work. Monitors and analyzes costs and prepares budgets.

Employee Management Ensures high quality employee attraction, engagement, and development at all levels. Builds bench strength through modeling ICARE/ILEAD and development of a high-performing culture. Work with regional management on succession planning.

Effectively manage all people issues including, but not limited to, labor, turnover, generational, and diversity and inclusion. Provides leadership and support for on-going training initiatives for management and employees. Develop a strong team of DC leaders and provide coaching and appropriate development opportunities for direct reports.

Directs staff to provide a work environment that fosters creativity, productivity, collaboration, and accountability. Maintains an engaged work environment by having a strong and friendly presence both on the floor and in the office.

Acts as an advocate for the facility’s management team to ensure swift resolution to both software and hardware problems. General Management and Operations Collaborates with both regional management and local management to develop and align strategic initiatives to implement locally.

Actively oversees DC operations and management by giving work direction, resolving problems, setting deadlines to ensure timely completion of work. Develops the vision for the facility, while tracking current processes and regularly assessing if best practices are in place.

Collaborates with colleagues in other 3PL operations to drive consistency or processes and the development of the RxCrossroads by McKesson 3PL brand. Financial Ownership Utilizes financial acumen and knowledge, especially in making business decisions. Monitors and analyze costs and assist the management team in making budget.

Directs local operations to ensure building’s performance is within budget and expense plans. Cross-Function Partnerships Collaborates with stakeholders from HR, Engineering, Six Sigma, Finance, and more to ensure operations are identifying, meeting, and exceeding desired output and best practices.

Coordinates with Transportation team and Contractors. Strategizes with leaders across the network to stay ahead of changing customer needs, industry advances, and labor planning concerns. Facilitates success within the building by monitoring, preventing and solving any concerns outside of the distribution center.

Compliance and Safety Oversee compliance with federal, state, local, and company policies and safety regulations. Assist the management team in diagnosing any safety concerns and creating ideal solutions. Ensure the building is always prepared for either an internal or external audit.

Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities): Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 6+ years of relevant professional experience and 0-2 years of supervisory experience. Critical Skills Capable of handling multiple priorities and extensive time demands regarding both logistics and employee problems and engagement.

Effectively navigates through complex situations, both internal and external, that may require multiple decision makers. Advanced knowledge of Operations/Distribution/Pharma Supply Chain Management. Excellent organizational skills, excellent communication skills (verbal/written), management skills, and contract negotiations.

Advanced financial and business acumen to include knowledge of key financial statements drivers and levers. Ability to develop, drive, implement and maintain innovation and promote continuous improvement around engineering processes, customer support, cost structure and quality initiatives. Experience with DEA regulation compliance.

Florida Designated Representative licensed. Additional Skills Strong PC skills and the ability to use McKesson’s suite of PC-based applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Microsoft, Outlook, etc.). Experience with warehouse management systems. Six Sigma training or continuous improvement experience.

SAP experience is a plus Working Conditions: Multiple environments including office and warehouse. Must be willing to work various hours to manage across the 24-hour work day within the distribution center.

A growth opportunity — early-career talent ready to step into a mature operations role is strongly encouraged to apply.
The Bike Club, we're on a mission to make sustainable, high-quality cycling accessible to every family. Our subscription model lets kids always ride the right-sized bike — and when they grow, we swap it out, refurbish it, and pass it on. With 80,000+ bikes on the road, $50M+ in funding, and rapid expansion across Europe, we're just getting started.
We're looking for a Lean Operations Manager to drive continuous improvement across our warehouse, refurbishment, and fulfilment operations in Rainham, London. This is a hands-on, gemba-first role for someone who thrives on the warehouse floor, loves solving operational puzzles, and turns observation and data into measurable change.
We've intentionally designed this as a single, broad role with real scope — and we're open to candidates at very different career stages. If you're early in your career but ambitious, structured, and hungry to step up, this is a rare chance to grow into a senior-style operations. If you're more experienced, you'll find plenty of room to take ownership from day one.
You'll partner closely with our warehouse leads, mechanics, customer service, and last-mile partners to remove waste, increase throughput, and make every refurbished bike move faster and more reliably from intake to family. Your work will directly shape how we scale a circular operation across Europe.
Tasks
Drive the continuous improvement roadmap across intake, refurbishment, dispatch, and returns — set priorities, run the program, and report progress to leadership
Map value streams end-to-end (bike intake → refurb → QC → outbound → courier → customer → return) and identify the bottlenecks, waste, and rework slowing us down
Run kaizen workshops, A3 problem-solving sessions, and structured root-cause analyses with mechanics, warehouse operators, and team leads
Define, track, and improve operational KPIs (cycle time, refurb throughput, first-time-right rate, on-time dispatch, returns turnaround, OEE on key stations)
Roll out standard work, 5S, visual management, and pull-based flow across the warehouse and refurb workshop
Spend significant time on the floor — observing, coaching, and validating that improvements stick after rollout
Lead capacity and layout planning as we scale: workstation design, station balancing, tool placement, and bike flow
Partner with last-mile and courier providers to reduce failed deliveries, returns leakage, and customer waiting time
Build the data and reporting backbone we need to manage operations by fact (Excel, WMS, Salesforce, BI tools)
Coach team leads and operators in lean thinking, building improvement capability across the organisation

A genuine gemba mindset — you'd rather be on the warehouse floor than behind a desk
Structured, analytical problem-solving — you can break a messy operational problem down and use data (Excel at minimum) to point at the answer
Strong communication and collaboration skills — comfortable working with mechanics and operators just as easily as with senior stakeholders
Pragmatic, organised, and biased to action — you thrive in a fast-moving scale-up where things change weekly
A relevant degree (industrial engineering, logistics, supply chain, business engineering, or similar)
Some real exposure to operations — through internships, working student roles, a first full-time job, a thesis project, or a few years of hands-on experience
Real curiosity about lean / continuous improvement — bonus points for a Lean Six Sigma certification (Yellow, Green, or Black Belt) or demonstrated kaizen / value stream experience
Confidence with operational systems (WMS, ERP, Salesforce, ticketing tools); SQL or BI tooling is a plus, not a requirement
Fluent English (working language); German is a strong plus
Bonus: interest or experience in circular economy, refurbishment, subscription business models, or sustainable mobility

Holidays – 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Private medical insurance

Parental leave – enhanced maternity and paternity leave
Bike subscription – £30 on Bike Club subscriptions
Sustainability impact – you will be working for a B Corp Certified company that actively contributes to environmental and social good
If you're earlier in your career and not sure you tick every box: please apply anyway. Drive, structure, and a willingness to learn matter more to us than years on a CV.

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Sales Operations Manager to serve as a strategic engine driving our global B2B revenue execution.
About AMBOSS
AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology.

Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2011 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari.
Why can this position be exciting for you?
You will act as the operational backbone bridging sales strategy, data analytics, process optimization, and cutting-edge tech integration across our global teams.
This is a high-impact role for a proactive problem solver and critical thinker. You won’t just be pulling reports; you’ll be translating raw data into actionable insights that directly influence sales strategy, integrating AI-driven workflows and managing senior cross-functional stakeholders. If you thrive at the intersection of strategic thinking, hands-on operations, and collaborative team enablement, this is the place for you.

Drive Revenue Strategy & Execution: Partner with sales leadership to manage territory design, quota allocation, product pricing, sales funnel performance, and sales attainment tracking across global B2B markets.
Optimize & Automate Processes: Map, streamline, and scale end-to-end sales processes. Leverage AI tools and modern automation to eliminate friction, boost sales team productivity, and accelerate deal velocity.
Master the Data & Analytics: Architect, automate, and maintain dashboards and reporting (e.g., Looker, HubSpot, Excel) to monitor revenue metrics and core KPIs, providing leadership with clarity on performance drivers.
Lead Stakeholder Management: Serve as the strategic operational bridge between Sales, Market Teams and Finance, managing cross-functional alignment, expectation setting, and business requests.
Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Identify, test, and implement AI skills, routines and workflow automations to improve pipeline forecasting,streamline the reporting and reduce operational workload.
Partner on CRM Architecture: Collaborate closely with CRM experts to share sales feedback and ensure clean pipeline governance, seamless data integration, and high portal adoption across global teams.

Relevant Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Sales or Revenue Operations, Consulting or Financial Analytics within a B2B SaaS or high-growth environment.
Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving: A proven track record of taking complex, ambiguous operational problems, analyzing the root cause, and building scalable, structured solutions.
AI Knowledge & Tech Savviness: Strong interest in and hands-on familiarity with AI tools and proficiency across the revenue tech stack (HubSpot, Looker, Google Sheets, Miro, Notion).
Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Skills: Ability to articulate technical or complex analytical ideas clearly to diverse audiences and build trust across departments.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven capability to independently own high-stakes cross-functional projects end-to-end, setting timelines, aligning conflicting priorities, and delivering outcomes.
Commercial Acumen: Understanding of B2B sales cycles, sales funnel mechanics, territory planning, pricing structures, and incentive models.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die Rolle als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen internen Fachbereichen und externen Netzwerkbetreibern und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit aus einer operativen sowie strategischen Perspektive.

Du entwickelst und dokumentierst interne Prozesse, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten sowie externe Prozessketten mit Netzwerkbetreibern, um Transparenz, Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
Dein Profil
Du analysierst komplexe Prozesse, erkennst Zusammenhänge über verschiedene Abteilungen, Unternehmen und Stakeholder hinweg und entwickelst eigenständig nachhaltige Lösungen, die operative Anforderungen und strategische Ziele miteinander verbinden.
Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzt Prioritäten auch in dynamischen Umfeldern und behältst selbst bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen und zeitkritischen Themen den Überblick sowie eine hohe Ergebnisqualität.
Du verstehst unterschiedliche Perspektiven von Kunden, Netzwerkbetreibern, internen Fachbereichen und Management, führst diese Interessen zusammen und schaffst durch analytisches Denken und klare Kommunikation tragfähige Entscheidungen und gemeinsame Vorgehensweisen.
Du bringst ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, Empathie und Menschlichkeit mit, förderst eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit zwischen allen Beteiligten und überzeugst durch professionelles Stakeholder-Management auf operativer und strategischer Ebene.
Du verfügst idealerweise über Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld sowie im Aufbau und der Optimierung von Prozessen, Projekten und Organisationsstrukturen; erste Führungsverantwortung oder nachgewiesene Koordinations- und Steuerungserfahrung sind von Vorteil, um Teams, Partner und Projekte erfolgreich zum gemeinsamen Ziel zu führen
Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.

Comfrt is looking for a Sample Operations Manager to build, manage, and optimize our end-to-end sample operations process for all marketing samples.

You'll serve as the operational hub between Product Development, Merchandising, Creative, Marketing, Photography, Social Media, Operations, and overseas vendors, making sure every sample lands accurately and on time for development, photoshoots, campaigns, wear testing, executive reviews, and product launches.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is highly proactive, thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds scalable processes, and can independently manage competing priorities while holding the line on accuracy and urgency.

Sample Operations Management
Own the end-to-end sample lifecycle across all product categories and seasons.
Build and maintain a centralized sample management system that provides real-time visibility across the organization.
Manage all inbound and outbound creator photography, marketing, creative, executive, and wear-test samples.
Ensure all samples are accurately tracked from vendor shipment through internal distribution and return.
Develop standardized operating procedures for sample handling, tracking, storage, and distribution.
Continuously improve sample workflows to increase efficiency and reduce delays.
Maintain digital libraries of sample imagery and approvals for internal visibility.
Ensure all submissions are organized, documented, and easily accessible.
Sample Request & Calendar Management
Manage all sample requests across Product Development, Creative, Marketing, Merchandising, Social Media, Photography, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
Prioritize competing requests while ensuring critical business milestones are achieved.
Understand the seasonal marketing calendar and proactively plan sample requirements to support all campaigns, launches, photoshoots, creator partnerships, and key business initiatives.
Coordinate sample readiness to align with product launch calendars and cross-functional deadlines.
Creative & Photo Studio Partnership
Partner closely with Creative and Photography teams to coordinate samples for all photoshoots.
Assist with outfit planning, product assortment, styling coordination, and sample selection for creative shoots.
Ensure all photography samples are complete, organized, steamed, tagged, and delivered on schedule.
Coordinate sample returns and inventory reconciliation following photoshoots.
Vendor Communication
Serve as the primary operational contact for all sample-related communication with overseas vendors.
Manage daily communication through Email, WhatsApp, Slack, WeChat, and other communication platforms.
Follow up proactively on sample status, shipment timing, missing samples, and vendor action items.
Escalate risks early and drive timely resolutions to maintain business timelines.
Team Leadership & Development
Directly manage the Sample Coordinator, providing daily direction, coaching, training, and performance management.
Develop the Sample Coordinator's skills, knowledge, and career growth through regular feedback and development plans.
Establish team priorities and allocate workload to ensure all sample requests are completed accurately and on time.
Create clear processes, expectations, and accountability measures for the sample operations team.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and ongoing coaching.
Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency through process improvements, automation, and better resource planning.
Foster a collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented team culture.
Build and scale the Sample Operations function as the business grows, recommending additional resources when needed.
Serve as the escalation point for complex sample issues, cross-functional conflicts, and vendor challenges.
Team & Cross-Functional Management
Coordinate sample activities across multiple departments to ensure alignment on priorities.
Lead sample status meetings and communicate weekly updates to stakeholders.
Build scalable processes that support company growth.
Train future team members on sample management standards and best practices.
Foster accountability through clear communication, organization, and process ownership.
Data & Process Management
Build dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into sample status, vendor performance, and timeline adherence.
Analyze workflow bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
Maintain accurate sample inventory, tracking systems, and digital filing structures.
Ensure all sample documentation, shipping records, and approvals are organized and current.
Develop KPIs and reporting to measure sample turnaround time, on-time delivery, and operational performance.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Associate Product Operations Manager to support our Product organization in improving operational efficiency, cross-functional alignment, and consistency in how work moves through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC).

Working closely with, and at the direction of, the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team, this role will execute the day-to-day tactics that keep our Product Operating Model running smoothly, while building the experience and judgment to take on greater ownership over time.
Align: work closely with the Product Leadership, Senior Product Operations Manager, Product Managers, and cross-functional business partners to help ensure product work is clearly understood, decisions are communicated effectively, and teams stay aligned on priorities, dependencies, and readiness.
Enable: Help provide product teams with the means to complete routine and strategic tasks as efficiently as possible, by supporting key processes, maintaining tools and workflows, and bringing structure to how work is prepared, reviewed, and tracked.
Improve: Support continuous, iterative improvement of how teams work by helping identify bottlenecks, reducing time spent on non-core product activities, and reinforcing the systems, governance, and operating rhythms that support high-quality product work.

Product Operations is a multifaceted function that focuses on improving how the Product organization operates day to day, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enabling product teams to focus on what they do best: build great products. This role is a mixture of hands-on execution and support for continuous improvement, working under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team. In this role you will be responsible

Product Operating Model and Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) Support: Support the flow of work from intake through discovery, assessment, planning, and delivery by helping ensure requests are complete, handoffs are clear, and the right information is available at the right time.
Intake and Initiative Readiness: Support the intake process by serving as a first line of review for incoming requests. Work with stakeholders to gather required inputs and help ensure work is ready for Product review and decision-making.
Operating Rhythm and Meeting Support: Help prepare, coordinate, and, where appropriate, facilitate recurring forums such as Weekly Business Reviews, roadmap reviews, stakeholder meetings, and leadership sessions. Ensure materials are organized, decisions are captured, and follow-up actions are tracked to completion.
Tools and Workflow Optimization: Maintain the product management tech stack, including workflow hygiene, documentation practices, and reporting accuracy, and flag opportunities to improve transparency and usability across Product and cross-functional teams.
Governance and Process Support: Support key operating processes including compliance reviews, cross-functional readiness, and other recurring governance needs that help the business interact effectively with Product.
Cross-functional Project and Program Support: Support the execution of select cross-functional initiatives directed by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Managers, helping track alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across teams.
Data-informed Execution: Help gather and organize data, reporting, and operational insights to support the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership in identifying trends and informing process improvements.
Iterative Improvement: Help ensure product operating processes, frameworks, and methodologies remain practical and fit for purpose. Support the rollout of improvements as directed, with a bias toward progress over perfection.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Support open communication and help facilitate alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders, ensuring teams are working effectively toward common goals.
Team Support: Support onboarding, training, and documentation efforts led by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership, helping build repeatable ways of working across the Product Organization.

Experience: 2-5 years in product operations, program management, project management, product management, or a similar role, ideally within a technology or product-focused organization.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcomed.
Skill Set
Product Operations is a strategic support function for the business that is as much about coordinating people as it is technology and processes. The strongest candidates will be comfortable owning tactical, day-to-day operational work while building the skills to help identify ways to improve how the organization works over time.
Predominantly, candidates from product operations, program or project management, business operations, product management, business analysis, or similar roles may bring the right mix of execution, organization, and process improvement experience to the position.
An understanding of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including intake, discovery, assessment, planning, release, and cross-functional readiness processes.
Works iteratively and pragmatically - eager to help improve the way teams work over time without over-engineering or trying to change everything at once.
A logical and analytical mindset, with a developing ability to understand what can be changed, what value change can bring, and comfort using data to support recommendations.
An empathetic attitude to truly understand the problems you are trying to support and solve with your colleagues and stakeholders.
Comfort with ambiguity, resilience to change, and the ability to adapt while working across multiple priorities and teams.
Experience managing task management and workflow tools - e.g. Jira, Linear, Asana, Productboard, or similar platforms.
Ability to help maintain, organize, and refine knowledge bases and documentation structures using the most suitable information architecture and documentation solution at hand - e.g. Confluence, Notion, etc.
Ability to help use product, process, or operational data to support better decision-making and surface relevant insights from available reporting and analytics.
Experience supporting the administration, adoption, and improvement of software tools and workflows in general.
Comfort supporting meetings and presentations with multiple stakeholders, with growing confidence in facilitating and presenting over time.
Comfort working with all levels of the business - from senior leaders to individual contributors - and a willingness to make suggestions and support positive change under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership.

Do you want to impact the hardest working people in the world?

With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Jobber is looking for a Principal Revenue Operations Manager —a rare blend of strategist, builder, and innovator—to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of go-to-market (GTM) strategy, advanced tooling, and experimental growth engineering. Partner with GTM leadership on strategic planning for pipeline coverage, channel strategy, capacity, and forecasting.
Act as a senior mentor within RevOps, guiding junior team members while championing innovation and experimentation.

Own relationships with data vendors and data strategy

Architect, test, and scale top-of-funnel and outbound lead generation experiments using modern AI/automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Clay, Supabase, and n8n).
Embed experimentation in the sales development lifecycle—running A/B tests, refining ICP outreach, and establishing scalable demand capture tactics.
Regularly engage directly with customers or prospects to validate hypotheses, improve conversion systems, and optimize customer journey handoffs.

Own components of our GTM systems strategy: marketing automation, outbound enablement, enrichment, reporting, etc.
Lead the technical transformation of our revenue tech stack, including API integration, low-code automation (e.g., n8n), and AI augmentation.

Own, operate, and iterate on production outbound and lifecycle automation — including monitoring, debugging, and improving live n8n workflows and scoring pipelines.

Excellent communicator with a bias toward action, systems thinking, and rapid iteration.
Strong knowledge of SQL database language.

A strong, supportive culture rooted in humility, impact, and giving a sh*t.

Vino Digital ist die E-Commerce-Agentur für die Weinbranche und ein Geschäftsbereich der TAFKA GmbH. An einem Tag steuerst du ein Kundenprojekt, am nächsten löst du ein Problem mit Shop, DNS oder Tracking, schneidest ein Video in DaVinci Resolve oder entwickelst mit Claude und Codex einen besseren Workflow.

Wenn du Verantwortung magst, digitale Systeme schnell verstehst und einen vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag suchst, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.
Aufgaben
Digitale Projekte führen: Du übernimmst Vino-Digital-Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst Beteiligte und hältst Zeit, Qualität und nächste Schritte im Blick.
Kunden sicher begleiten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für ausgewählte Partnerweingüter, führst Termine, übersetzt Ziele in klare Arbeitspakete und löst Probleme proaktiv.
Systeme weiterentwickeln: Du sammelst wiederkehrende Anforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen, formulierst saubere Briefings für Entwicklung und Automatisierung, testest neue Funktionen und dokumentierst den fertigen Prozess.
Technische Themen lösen: Du arbeitest sicher mit CMS, Domains, DNS-Einträgen, Formularen, Tracking und Integrationen. Bei Fehlern grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein und organisierst eine belastbare Lösung.
Web und E-Commerce umsetzen: Du pflegst und verbesserst Seiten in Shopify, WordPress oder vergleichbaren Systemen und kannst kleinere Anpassungen selbst durchführen.
Videos produzieren: Du schneidest Social-, Performance-, Schulungs- und Kunden-Videos in DaVinci Resolve, inklusive Auswahl, Dramaturgie, Ton, Untertiteln und passenden Exportformaten.
AI-first arbeiten: Du nutzt Claude und Codex täglich für Planung, Recherche, Dokumentation, Troubleshooting, Text, Prototyping und kleine technische Umsetzungen. Ergebnisse prüfst und verbesserst du eigenständig.
TAFKA unterstützen: Je nach Auslastung übernimmst du passende Aufgaben in KI-, Automatisierungs- oder Content-Projekten von TAFKA, etwa Projektkoordination, Prototyping, Video-Deliverables oder Qualitätssicherung.
Standards verbessern: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Reibung, entwickelst Vorlagen und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen im Team wiederverwendbar werden.

Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Agentur, einem Digitalunternehmen, einem E-Commerce-Team, einem Start-up oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit.
Du hast mehrere digitale Projekte mit eigener Kunden- oder Stakeholder-Verantwortung geführt und kannst konkret erklären, welche schwierigen Situationen du gelöst und welche Ergebnisse du erreicht hast.
Du kommunizierst verbindlich, priorisierst klar und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn Anforderungen unvollständig sind oder kurz vor einem Termin ein Problem auftaucht.
Du verstehst die Grundlagen von Domains und DNS. Begriffe wie A-Record, CNAME, MX und TXT sind dir vertraut.
Du hast bereits eine Website oder einen Shop mit WordPress, Shopify, Webflow oder einem vergleichbaren CMS umgesetzt oder wesentlich weiterentwickelt.
Du hast praktische Schnitt-Erfahrung mit DaVinci Resolve und kannst Arbeitsproben zeigen. Grundlagen bei Ton, Farbe, Untertiteln und Social-Formaten sitzen.
Du nutzt Claude, Codex oder vergleichbare KI-Werkzeuge routiniert und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Qualität, Tempo oder Problemlösung verbessert hast.
Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Prozesse so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können.
Du arbeitest auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und kannst dich im beruflichen Alltag auf Englisch verständigen.
Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz in Berlin arbeiten: 3 Tage pro Woche
Ein Studium ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Berufspraxis, dein Urteilsvermögen und die Ergebnisse, für die du bereits Verantwortung getragen hast. Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding, APIs, Webhooks oder Automationen ist willkommen.

Echte Verantwortung: Du führst eigene Projekte und hast direkten Einfluss auf Kunden, Abläufe und Produktqualität.
Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit erkennbarem Kern: Projektmanagement bildet deine Basis. Technik, Systeme, Video und KI geben dir Raum, weitere Stärken einzusetzen.
Zwei spannende Arbeitsfelder: Du arbeitest überwiegend für Vino Digital und kannst dich zusätzlich in ausgewählte KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte von TAFKA einbringen.
AI-first-Umfeld: Claude, Codex und moderne Automatisierungswerkzeuge gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Experimente können schnell zum neuen Standard werden.
Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Team und der Geschäftsführung und kannst Verbesserungen selbst anstoßen.
Gute Ausstattung: Du erhältst ein Firmen-MacBook und die Software, die du für deine Arbeit brauchst.
Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz, die übrige Zeit ist flexibel. Remote Work über einen abgestimmten Zeitraum nach Probezeit problemlos möglich.
Du hast schon erlebt, wie digitale Projekte in der Realität laufen: mit Kundenwünschen, Abhängigkeiten, technischen Überraschungen und Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck. Du behältst den Überblick, packst selbst mit an und findest einen gangbaren nächsten Schritt.

🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!
At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people .
Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.
Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital , with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.
As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!

s.h: 💡 Your Mission: Turn growth into a system!
s.t:
Hi, I'm Jeremy, I lead RevOps at voize. I'm hiring the person who owns sales operations as we scale: new markets, new segments, and a sales team growing fast in all of them.
As Sales Operations Manager, you build the GTM engine that carries us past €100M ARR, working in close partnership with our sales leaders, with genuinely good tooling and AI ways of working behind you. Joining at this point in our hyper-growth journey is rare: big enough that the problems are real, early enough that you shape how they get solved. What you build now compounds for years, and so does your scope.
This role is roughly 60% building new process and 40% running what exists. If you want a mature machine to optimize, this is not it. If you want to design the machine, for now and for what comes next, it is.
🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike
Territory, compensation & capacity. Own the global account, territory and book-of-business model. Carve books for new AEs, keep segmentation honest as we add hospitals and new geos, and build the capacity and quota model that underpins our fiscal plan.
Forecasting. Run the forecast process end to end with our VP Sales and team leads: weekly hygiene, submit and roll-up, quarterly commit. Diagnose why deals slip, and stand the process up in the US, France and UK as those teams ramp.
Insights the company acts on. Define the sales metrics we run on, then turn pipeline and funnel data into the analysis that steers board meetings, monthly GTM reviews and weekly deal inspection. You define what gets measured; our data and BI team build the layer underneath.
Commercial process. Design how non-standard deals are managed at voize. You set the rules and stand the function up; you will not be the approval queue.
Process and tool enablement. In close collaboration with sales enablement, you make sure what gets built actually gets adopted, partnering with leaders, AEs and SDRs to prioritize the work with the most impact.
The GTM stack, built AI-first. Own the sales side of CRM and the tools around it. Automate the manual layer with Claude, n8n and whatever else earns its place, and take a real position on which tooling we buy next as we scale.

s.h: 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table
s.t:
3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or GTM strategy , at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or in strategy/tech consulting, VC or M&A before an operating role. You have seen what breaks as a sales team scales, because you were the one who fixed it.
Exceptional stakeholder skills. You partner with VPs and team leads as an equal, push back with evidence, and get change adopted by people who do not report to you.
Sharp analytical instincts and deep CRM fluency. Expert in spreadsheets, comfortable reading data in a BI tool, and you have owned a HubSpot or Salesforce instance rather than just worked in one. You go deep on data enrichment and spot the patterns that keep our data model trustworthy.
You have supported forecasting. You can talk methodology, where it broke, and what you changed. Same for a territory or quota plan you built and aligned with sales leadership.
Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on. You are comfortable with no playbook, you prioritize ruthlessly, and you ship rather than produce recommendations.
AI-native as a builder, not just a user. You already use Claude, n8n or similar to remove manual work from your own day, and you can point to something concrete you shipped that way.
🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize
We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will take on real problems, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people
We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany
Become a co-creator of our success with stock options
Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses
You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The opportunity
We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.
You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.
You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.
You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.
What you’ll work on
Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.
Now
Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.
Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes
Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.
Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.
Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.
Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.
Next
Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.
Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.
Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.
Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.
Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.
Later
Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.
Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.
Support company secretarial administration.

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.
Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.
Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.
Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.
Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.
End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.
Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.
Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.
Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

The National Service & Solutions (NS&S) organization is a dynamic organization committed to delivering best-in-class care for clients and internal partners.

We specialize in situations that require a compassionate touch, high attention to detail, management of high risks, adjustments for unique product or situation combinations and education of internal partners. We respond rationally, but rapidly to an ever-evolving set of products, compliance requirements, and client needs.

NS&S practices process excellence in every facet of our operation and is committed to creating a work environment that drives positive employee engagement and growth. NS&S delivers high quality care for internal and external clients with complex situations or escalated calls and chats involving high risk requests, multiple products and unique needs.

NS&S uses a call center/contact center structure to engage with external clients and Financial Centers all over the country. NS&S is committed to continuous improvement of their processes and skill development for their employees.
The NS&S Team is seeking an experienced and motivated individual to join our high performing team as an Operations Manager.
This job is responsible for leading a segment or a small operations unit for a site, region, or product line within the bank's internal operations.

Key responsibilities include identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex problems, ensuring compliance with policies, and developing and implementing new processes to improve operating efficiency and ensure accuracy of workflow.

Job expectations include overseeing day-to-day activities of employees, including executing transactions and managing the budget, expenses, forecasting, and reporting.

Forecasts and manages staffing levels and capacities, provides effective coaching, and shares constructive feedback to drive Operational Excellence
Applies knowledge of the end-to-end processes and ensures adherence to bank and regulatory policy and procedures when making decisions that impact various operations and product lines
Develops and analyzes procedures to enhance unit and/or product-related activities and oversees budget and expense management, reporting, and forecasting for designated areas
Evaluates efficiencies and identifies areas of improvement and growth to the overall process, identifying data, metrics, and key performance indicators to measure process effectiveness
Aligns bank priorities and strategies to employee metrics and goals and strives to recognize, encourage, and improve team performance to support an inclusive work environment
As a member of an NS&S site leadership team, an Operations Team Manager
Enables and empowers 11+ employees to deliver on the Client Care Pillars easily and efficiently via case management
Maintains a full understanding of the team's performance. Understanding the performance of each person, using long- and short-term analysis of key performance indicators, observations, and anecdotal information
Identifies positive and negative patterns driving the performance
Coaches the team and individuals to sustain positive patterns and mitigate negative patterns to improve or sustain performance
Sustains a process excellence culture to maintain consistent and iterative improvements in all aspects of the operation and employee experience
Actively participates in routines and practices to accurately assess key performance indicators and executes on actions needed to improve and maintain the health of the operation and the employee experience
Executes long and short-term strategic plans to drive improvements in client care, efficiency, employee engagement and growth
Makes sound judgements based on data to balance risks with rewards, maintain control discipline, and respond to change
Engages in ongoing personal education to maintain a current working knowledge of the market, technology that would benefit the operation, best practices in employee engagement, and updated skill set

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Creates an inclusive team where members are treated fairly and respectfully.

Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Delivers clear and concise messages that motivate, convey the "why" and connects contributions to business results.
Risk Manager: Leads and encourages the identification, escalation and resolution of potential risks.
People Manager & Coach: Knows and develops team members through coaching and feedback.
Financial Steward: Manages expenses and demonstrates an owner's mindset.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Recruits, on-boards and develops talent, and supports talent mobility for career growth.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results through effective team management, structure, and routines.
